[[File:Ambassador_Commons.png|thumb|right|200px|Ambassador Commons, an Alien Enclave]]
An '''Alien Enclave''' was a special district of the [[City/Legends|city]] of [[Voss-Ka]] on [[Voss]] that was reserved for outsiders and off-worlders. Outsiders were not permitted into Voss-Ka proper, so the Alien Enclaves were constructed for the off-worlders. The [[Ambassador Commons]] near the [[Tower of Prophecy]] was one such Enclave.
